rooms.title: Biology lab
rooms.description: A teaching biology laboratory with rows of benches, microscopes and glassware, sinks, fume hoods and a chalkboard.

rooms.title: Rehab center
rooms.description: A bright rehabilitation therapy hall with connected areas for supported walking, mobility practice, transfers, fitted aids, exercise and daily living. Adjustable equipment and movable accessories share clear circulation routes. Furnishings and accessories use rigid physical approximations.

rooms.title: Children's room
rooms.description: A children's playroom with a study corner: toys and play furniture, a wooden garage and railway, a bed, a desk and storage.

rooms.title: Delivery room
rooms.description: A hospital labour and delivery room with a birthing bed, medical equipment and a baby warmer, a family sofa under the windows, a privacy curtain and an attached bathroom.

rooms.title: Parcel sorting room
rooms.description: A parcel sorting hall: an induction belt and roller lanes, a row of wire dispatch cages, packing tables with computers and scanners, and an exception bench with problem crates.

rooms.title: Humanoid test lab
rooms.description: A humanoid robotics test laboratory with a matte black panel enclosure and one grey door curtain. It has climbing obstacles and crash pads, a mobile crane carrying a humanoid, and a parts-sequencing area with slotted carts, picking bins, a roller conveyor and a small laptop and battery trolley.

rooms.title: Auto repair
rooms.description: An automotive repair and bodywork training workshop with a passenger-car service bay, two-post lift, frame-repair bench, paint-booth entrance and wheel-service equipment. Along the tiled walls are tool panels, steel workbenches and drawer cabinets, with jacks, an oil-drain caddy, utility carts and parts storage around the bays; the hatchback's hood is raised above its engine bay.

rooms.title: School front office
rooms.description: A school front office with visitor reception, staff printing and filing, a homework lounge and a semi-open office.

rooms.title: Living room with pool
rooms.description: An open-plan living area with sofas around coffee tables, a round dining table, a grand piano and a bar, opening through glass doors onto a sunroom and an outdoor pool.

rooms.title: F6 commercial kitchen
rooms.description: A dense commercial kitchen with cooking and prep counters, stocked pan shelving, cold storage, and a lifting-hood dishwasher at the dish-return line. Tasks cover cookware handling, dish return, appliance controls, and cotton towel and mat manipulation.
